title: Mall world Arcade
content: First post in this sub Often times when I dream of mall world, I find myself following a dark series of hallways until I find an arcade / water park, a lot of the arcade games are broken, the ones that do work aren’t necessarily real games but in the dream world they make sense. There’s one machine that always has coins and change falling out of it. There’s also a reoccurring Simpsons pinball machine that gives you a Bart plushy, but doesn’t always function. There’s a vending machine with bizarre snacks in it, I often find myself trying to gather coins to buy something from the vending machine, it either malfunctions or doesn’t work at all. The water park side of this arcade has low ambient music playing, dark water slides sometimes with strobing lights in them, I should mention I never see anyone else in the arcade or water park. At the end of the water slides there’s an exit that takes you outside to a series of abandoned buildings + forest.
